integrity.method: Exact discrete-Morse computation with full finite integral boundary matrices and separate reverse-order mod-two calculation.
integrity.proof_scope: Integral homotopy equivalence for one graph with 24 vertices and 36 edges.

limitations: Graph-specific finite result for the Nauru graph GP(12,5); no generalized Petersen family classification is asserted.
Automorphism representation and maps to the ordinary matching complex are not determined.
An unindexed equivalent prior computation is a remaining bibliographic risk.
title: Exact mixed-dimensional homotopy of the Nauru perfect-matching complex
